name: @thoremin/sound-mapper
description: thoremin's sound mapper, framework-free: the sound map's schema (the player's sounds, the drum each plays, the taps that taught them), the models derived from the taps, and a vanilla zustand store holding one lease on the audio-input hub, persisted through a zodal named collection. The page that shows it is play/sound-mapper.html (TypeScript source, consumed through the workspace).
